items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 September 2026 3:54pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 18 September 2026 at 3:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Deepening area of low pressure near Iceland as a frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6 this evening, perhaps occasionally force 7 in the east overnight. Becoming west or southwest 4 to 6 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate by tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Patchy rain or drizzle, clearing to become fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, perhaps occasionally moderate or poor in any rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, veering west or northwest 4 or 5 later Sunday morning and 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming slight later on Sunday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
